summary: Averis Seeds breeds, multiplies and trades starch potato varieties and supplies seed potatoes to starch potato growers in the Netherlands and Germany. It is based in Veendam and was formed in 2001 as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the potato starch cooperative Royal Avebe. It supplies at least 80% of the seed potatoes used by Avebe's growers.
ownership: Wholly-owned subsidiary of Coöperatie Koninklijke Avebe U.A.
products: Starch potato varieties (own, licensed and from affiliated growers)
Multiplication seed, class E (jumbo bags of 1,250 kg or 50 kg bags)
Starch seed, class A, on one- or two-year contracts
markets: Starch potato growing areas of the Netherlands
Starch potato growing areas of Germany
facts: Supplies at least 80% of the seed potatoes used by Avebe's growers
Breeding clones are tested for at least six years before larger trials
Over 70% of seed potatoes are delivered between February and May
NAK-ATR multiplication charged at EUR 1,000 per hectare in advance
Farm-saved-seed fee: EUR 34.40 per hectare (2026), rising to EUR 50.00 (2029)

contact.address: Prins Hendrikplein 20, 9641 GK Veendam, the Netherlands

limitations: Seed hectares, tonnes, number of contract growers, employees, turnover and management names are not published on the pages read.
Export countries, research partners and use of minitubers or tissue culture are not stated.
